primary_recommendation.selection_basis: Highest target score WITHIN the Pareto frontier (ties broken by the route/round/experiment/candidate composite key ascending, because candidate_id repeats across rounds). No frontier member was removed by this choice.
primary_recommendation.cross_route_comparability_disclaimer: Cross-route target-score ordering is INDICATIVE ONLY. Each route normalizes its soft score against its own executable objective contract; the normalized values are not directly comparable between routes (red line 6). This ranking is used solely to pick the primary recommendation INSIDE the Pareto frontier -- it never removes any solution from the frontier, and every frontier member remains part of the delivered portfolio.

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 5 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Reducing the perturbation radius from ±12 nm to ±8 nm for layers 7-16 will increase sampling density near the current local optimum, allowing the optimizer to resolve gradient structure that was previously masked by excessive exploration volume, and should produce a measurable increase in best_target_score if the current solution is near but not at the local optimum.

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 5 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: The Round 2 optimum (target_score 0.8706) represents a valid local maximum that subsequent rounds failed to maintain due to overly restrictive bounds and integer-rounding post-processing. Resuming from this point with continuous-only optimization, reduced learning rate, and soft-boundary clipping will recover and potentially exceed the Round 2 performance.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (20 finite layers total, alternating high-low index starting with HfO2)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: A parametric quadratic chirp model (t_i = t_base + k·i + c·i²) with derivative clipping can achieve target scores ≥0.85 while maintaining physical chirp consistency and reducing optimization degrees of freedom from 28 to 3 parameters.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)

route_comparison.termination_reason: LLM explicitly assessed no further benefit after 4 executed rounds (stop_basis=marginal_gains_too_low)
